fields.Name: Time Logged by Person and Period
fields.UserQuestion: How much billable and non-billable time has each person logged per day across a date range?
fields.Description: Daily and total minutes (billable vs. non-billable) logged per person across an optional date range and person filter.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Aggregates __mj_BizAppsTasks.vwTaskTimeEntries by PersonID, Person, and WorkDate, with optional Nunjucks filters for StartDate, EndDate, and PersonID.

fields.Name: StartDate
fields.Description: Optional inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for WorkDate.

fields.Name: EndDate
fields.Description: Optional inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD) for WorkDate.

fields.Name: PersonID
fields.Description: Optional Person UUID filter.

fields.Name: Task Effort vs Estimate Rollup
fields.UserQuestion: How does rolled-up logged time and AI agent cost compare against estimated minutes across root project tasks?
fields.Description: Root tasks and their sub-trees with EstimatedMinutes, RolledUpLoggedMinutes, VarianceMinutes, PercentOfEstimate, RolledUpAgentRunCount, AgentTotalCost, and AgentTotalTokens.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Groups __mj_BizAppsTasks.vwTasks by RootParentID and joins back to root tasks (ParentID IS NULL) with optional Nunjucks filters for RootTaskID, CategoryID, and OnlyOverEstimate.

fields.Name: RootTaskID
fields.Description: Optional Root Task UUID filter.

fields.Name: CategoryID
fields.Description: Optional Task Category UUID filter.

fields.Name: OnlyOverEstimate
fields.Description: When 'true' or '1', filters to root tasks whose rolled-up logged minutes exceed EstimatedMinutes.

fields.Name: Agent Effort and Cost by Task
fields.UserQuestion: Which tasks incurred AI agent runs, tokens, and model cost, deduplicated across parent and child runs?
fields.Description: Tasks with linked AI agent runs (deduplicated against ancestor runs linked to the same task), total tokens, total cost, and wall-clock seconds.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Joins __mj_BizAppsTasks.TaskAgentRun to __mj_BizAppsTasks.vwTasks and __mj.vwAIAgentRuns, excluding runs whose ParentRunIDPath contains another run linked to the same task. Optional Nunjucks filters for StartDate, EndDate, AgentID, and RootTaskID.

fields.Name: StartDate
fields.Description: Optional inclusive start date for agent run StartedAt.

fields.Name: EndDate
fields.Description: Optional inclusive end date for agent run StartedAt.

fields.Name: AgentID
fields.Description: Optional AI Agent UUID filter.

fields.Name: RootTaskID
fields.Description: Optional Root Task UUID filter.

fields.Name: Timesheet Approval Status Summary
fields.UserQuestion: What is the submission and per-project approval status of timesheets across a period?
fields.Description: Timesheets and their latest submission round approval part counts (Approved, Pending, Rejected) with optional period, status, and approver filters.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Reads __mj_BizAppsTasks.vwTimesheets joined to the latest SubmissionRound in __mj_BizAppsTasks.TimesheetApproval. Optional Nunjucks filters for PeriodStart, PeriodEnd, Status, and ApproverPersonID.

fields.Name: PeriodStart
fields.Description: Optional inclusive period start filter.

fields.Name: PeriodEnd
fields.Description: Optional inclusive period end filter.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Optional Timesheet status filter (Draft, Submitted, Approved, Rejected).

fields.Name: ApproverPersonID
fields.Description: Optional Approver Person UUID filter.

fields.Name: Logged Time by Linked Record
fields.UserQuestion: How much human time, billable time, and AI agent cost has been logged across tasks linked to an external record?
fields.Description: Total human minutes, billable minutes, and AI agent cost across all tasks (and their descendant sub-tasks) linked to an external entity/record via TaskLink.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Joins __mj_BizAppsTasks.vwTaskLinks to __mj_BizAppsTasks.vwTasks (matching TaskID or RootParentID) and aggregates __mj_BizAppsTasks.TaskTimeEntry. Optional Nunjucks filters for EntityName, RecordID, StartDate, and EndDate.

fields.Name: EntityName
fields.Description: Optional target Entity Name filter on TaskLink.

fields.Name: RecordID
fields.Description: Optional target RecordID filter on TaskLink.

fields.Name: StartDate
fields.Description: Optional inclusive start date for TaskTimeEntry.WorkDate.

fields.Name: EndDate
fields.Description: Optional inclusive end date for TaskTimeEntry.WorkDate.
